gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Formed in 1956 by a group of dedicated historical enthusiasts in Springfield, the Springfield Art and Historical Society was originally housed in the Miller House located at 9 Elm Hill Street, the original home of Edward Miller. Our museum is now located at the Cota & Cota building in North Springfield.
